title: compose skill step 1 reads the task from an empty placeholder
body: What happened: the warden:compose skill text starts with 'Read the task from ``' with nothing between the backticks, so the task source is unclear. Expected: the skill names where the task text comes from (the user request or the skill args). Steps: invoke the compose skill from a chat request. Evidence: step 1 of the loaded skill text reads 'Read the task from ``. Keep the task id and the full what to do text'.
